scripts.build:all: npm run build:addon && npm run build
scripts.server:start: mkdir -p scratchpad && npx tsx src/openai-server.ts --chunk-size 8192 --batch-size 4 --port 8010 --host 0.0.0.0 --decode-latency 50 > scratchpad/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > scratchpad/server.pid && echo "Server starting (PID: $(cat scratchpad/server.pid)) logs: scratchpad/server.log"
scripts.server:stop: pkill -f 'node.*openai-server' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'tsx.*openai-server' 2>/dev/null; rm -f scratchpad/server.pid; echo 'Server stopped'
scripts.server:restart: npm run server:stop && sleep 1 && npm run server:start
scripts.test:server: npm run server:stop 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; npx tsx src/openai-server.ts --chunk-size 8192 --batch-size 4 --port 8010 --host 0.0.0.0 --decode-latency 0 > scratchpad/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > scratchpad/server.pid && sleep 5 && tsx --test tests/test_openai_server.ts; npm run server:stop
scripts.test:continuous-batching: npm run server:stop 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; npx tsx src/openai-server.ts --chunk-size 8192 --batch-size 4 --port 8010 --host 0.0.0.0 --decode-latency 50 > scratchpad/server.log 2>&1 & echo $! > scratchpad/server.pid && sleep 5 && tsx --test tests/test_continuous_batching.ts; npm run server:stop
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:node
